subject: Linguistics
title: Compositionality
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Compositionality.

hook.text: You've never heard 'the purple giraffe ate algebra' before—yet you understand it instantly.

buildup.text: The principle of compositionality says sentence meaning is built from word meanings plus structure.

discovery.text: Frege proposed this: know the parts and the rules, and you can compute any sentence's meaning.

twist.text: Idioms break compositionality—'kick the bucket' cannot be computed from its parts.

climax.text: Despite exceptions, compositionality explains how finite brains understand infinite sentences.

punchline.text: Meaning is parts plus rules—that's the recipe.

quiz.question: What is the principle of compositionality?
options: Sentence meaning comes from word meanings plus structure
Words have only one meaning each
